summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Orchitek landing page. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests pass covering health, enrollments (regular/student pricing 599900/499900), validation (422), test_mode short-circuit (order_id null, test_mode=true), persistence (create→list), Razorpay signature verification (bad sig 400, missing enrollment 404), and leads. Frontend: All sections render, all 5 enrollment CTAs (header, hero, plan-cta-regular, plan-cta-student, cta-enroll-btn) open the dialog. Plan/schedule preselection from pricing CTAs works correctly (Student->₹4,999, Regular->₹5,999). Test_mode short-circuit verified end-to-end: form submission shows success state without invoking Razorpay. WhatsApp float button has correct wa.me href. Mobile menu toggle works at 390px viewport. Anchor nav (#curriculum) works.

minor.issue: logger.error referenced before logger is defined (logger is defined on line 245, after the function). Currently unreachable in test_mode but will throw NameError if Razorpay is ever configured and order creation fails. Move logger definition above the routes.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid is on the wrapper element rather than the accordion trigger button; aria-expanded reads None on the testid element. The accordion likely still works visually but automated tests cannot reliably assert expanded state. Move data-testid onto the AccordionTrigger button.

action_items: Move `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` above route definitions in server.py so the logger.error in the Razorpay error branch (line 149) doesn't throw NameError when real keys are configured.
Move data-testid="faq-N" attribute onto the AccordionTrigger button so aria-expanded is queryable for automated tests.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger used before defined (line 149 inside create_enrollment) — logger is initialized at line 245. NameError will occur if Razorpay order.create() fails with real keys.
server.py: insert_one mutates the doc dict (adds _id). The OrderResponse return is built from payload, not doc, so this is safe — but if you ever return doc directly you must exclude _id.

EnrollmentDialog.jsx: form has HTML5 required on inputs which preempts the explicit toast.error validation for empty fields. Either remove required or remove the toast — current code is fine but redundant.

Pricing values are duplicated: backend constants (PRICE_REGULAR/STUDENT) and frontend PRICE = { regular: 5999, student: 4999 }. Consider exposing via /api/health or a /api/pricing endpoint to keep them in sync.
test_credentials: None — Razorpay placeholder mode, no auth.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed enrollment and lead docs in MongoDB (orchitek_db.enrollments / orchitek_db.leads). Not cleaned up; safe since they're test-prefixed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is healthy and stable in test_mode. The signature verification path is exercised with bad signatures only; if Razorpay is ever switched to live keys, add a positive HMAC test by signing with the secret. The logger-before-definition bug in server.py is dormant under test_mode and only manifests on real Razorpay failures.
